title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
script:
Deepgram acquired Daily to build out its voice AI infrastructure.
Daily is the creator of the open source framework Pipecat.
Pipecat lets developers build real time voice applications with speech models.
Deepgram provides speech to text models used across customer support workflows.
This buyout combines Deepgram audio transcription with Daily real time pipelines.
Deepgram confirmed it is committed to keeping Pipecat open source.
Would you build your next voice project with open source tools?
